name: agent-17
description: Mads Stoumann's agent skills for web launches, site safety, structured data, project health, agent memory and project setup

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Every skill in skills/ as one plugin: audit-all, audit-fix, audit-launch, audit-a11y, audit-seo, audit-eco, audit-privacy, audit-infra, audit-security, is-website-safe, audit-solution-health, check-node-toolchain, check-tech-stack, plan-geo and any skill added there later

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Memory management for a project's AI agents, in memory/: enable-memory-management, snapshot and any memory skill added there later

plugins.name: project
plugins.description: A small folder of structured markdown for a project and the skills that keep it true for the whole team, in project/: new (scaffold, interview, fill, resume), decide (record, supersede, accept a decision) and any project skill added there later
